spec_refs: VCSX-SPEC.md Section 8.5 "Versioning and the Version Grammar"
description: Map an invocation status to the process exit code of the subprocess encoding.
given: the invocation status (Section 8.2), or null where the invocation produced no result
notes: Part of the major-stable surface (Section 8.5): the mapping does not change within a MAJOR.
Small but load-bearing. Exit codes in the same domain are not interchangeable across projects, and `2` here means the policy did not run, not `needs_caller`.
The JSON envelope is emitted for each of the four status-bearing codes (Section 8.3), which is a behavior of the process rather than of this function.

A null status models an invocation that reached no Section 8.2 result. Section 8.3 reserves `1` for it and reads any code outside the four status-bearing ones the same way, so the inverse direction — code to meaning — is total. Only the reserved code is asserted here: what an engine's runtime produces on an abort is not a value this function returns.

vectors.description: A usage or configuration error (Section 6.11); the policy did not run.
An invocation that reached no Section 8.2 result is not a status: `1` names that condition, stdout carries nothing, and any code outside the four status-bearing ones means the same (Section 8.3).
